agent_role: Agent E - Final Independent Read-Only QA

overall_assessment.summary: Dashboard V2 satisfies the requested final QA gates for generated HTML/assets config presence, Korean-first information architecture, exact five primary menu items, fourteen unique top-level architecture nodes, easy/technical drawer modes, frozen scientific pilot values, local-only assets, reduced-motion contract, screenshot coverage, private exposure 0, and no observed registry/scientific file modifications.

static_checks.details: HTML/CSS/JS grep found no http(s) script/link/src references and no CDN markers.
index.html references local assets/rcc.css and assets/rcc.js only.

git diff --name-only returned no paths under research_control_center/registry, research_control_center/history, research_control_center/bootstrap, research_control_center/architecture, src/paperworks/contracts, src/paperworks/data, src/paperworks/metadata, src/paperworks/candidates, or src/paperworks/gdn.

checks.evidence: dashboard/assets/rcc.css, dashboard/assets/rcc.js, dashboard_config/architecture_nodes.csv, architecture_edges.csv, architecture_groups.json, dashboard_layout.json, display_labels_ko.json, visual_tokens.json present.
dashboard_layout.json primary_navigation contains overview, architecture, experiments, readiness, history; unittest test_exactly_five_primary_navigation_items passed.

dashboard view model unittest asserts 14 unique node_ids; dashboard_layout.json and load_dashboard_config agree. Raw HTML contains 28 data-node-id matches because the same 14 nodes appear once in overview mini-map and once in architecture view.

checks.requirement: Drawer supports easy and technical modes
checks.evidence: index.html includes data-drawer-mode="easy" and data-drawer-mode="technical" tabs; screenshot 03 shows drawer open.
No external script/link/src references found; JS contains no fetch or XMLHttpRequest.
unittest test_local_links_resolve passed for href/src references.
rcc.css includes @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) removing transitions and animations.
html lang="ko"; primary labels are Korean-first; screenshots 01, 04, 05, 08 show Korean headings and labels dominating user-facing content while D0/D1/D2/META/STAT/GDN identifiers remain intact.
Embedded view model safety block reports private_exposures=0, scientific_executions=0, test2_accesses=0; no private paths or raw restricted values observed in screenshots or HTML.
No diffs detected in designated registry/scientific paths.
1440x900 and 1920x1080 screenshots show stable layout, readable hierarchy, no visible overlap, no clipped key panels, and compact architecture map plus action/risk panels above the fold.
390x844 screenshot shows mobile header, menu toggle, single-column stacking, readable cards, and architecture map within scrollable frame without text clipping.

Skip link, visible focus styling, semantic header/nav/main/section, keyboard-focusable SVG nodes, aria labels, aria-expanded, aria-hidden, drawer tabs, and accessible data table are present; related unittest passed.

limitations: This QA was read-only and did not modify shared implementation, registry, or scientific files.
Accessibility verification was contract-driven plus screenshot/manual review; no live screen-reader session was executed in this pass.
The dedicated unittest covered structure, values, local links, accessibility hooks, and no-external-runtime constraints, but it does not prove real browser assistive-technology behavior by itself.

The provided mobile screenshot confirms responsive stacking at 390x844, but no separate screenshot was supplied for mobile drawer-open technical mode; code and desktop screenshot indicate the feature exists.
